visualCharacteristics: White promo cards: 4x3 image on top, small uppercase kicker above a condensed title; columns follow the card count (2-up, 3-up or 4-up); an image-less card renders as a TV schedule card with a red label, listings, a dark 'Watch Live TV' pill and a bottom link

cells: 4x3 image (leave empty for a text-only schedule card)

Kicker paragraph, then H3 title link. Schedule card: label paragraph (SCHEDULE), then per listing an eyebrow paragraph (UP NEXT), bold show name paragraph and time paragraph ('3pm | 2c'); link-only paragraphs are actions, the last one is pinned to the bottom
contentPattern.structure: two cells: a 4x3 image, then a kicker paragraph and an H3 title link. Leave the image cell empty for a text-only TV schedule card (label, eyebrow/bold show/time lines, link-only paragraphs as actions)

usage.description: Homepage promo rows such as 'Recipes and Shows You Don't Want to Miss' (3 cards + schedule) and 'Shop With Us' (2 cards).

reuseGuidance: Use for promo cards that need a kicker label above the title. Author 2, 3 or 4 cards per row set; more than 4 wrap 4-up (3-up when the count divides by 3 but not 4). For image + title only, use cards-gallery.
